Character sprites extracted from Yomegami - My Sweet Goddess!
(よめがみ My Sweet Goddess!).

The game uses the KiriKiri2 engine and constructs character sprites
from multiple image layers. Although a very large number of theoretical
layer combinations can be generated, many of them are not actually
used or valid in the game.

This gallery contains all valid character sprite combinations defined
by the game's original composition rules.

从《よめがみ My Sweet Goddess!》游戏资源中提取的人物立绘。

本作使用 KiriKiri2 引擎，人物立绘由多个图层组合生成。
虽然理论上可以生成大量不同的图层组合，但其中许多组合并不会在
游戏中实际使用，也不符合游戏原本的立绘组合规则。

本画廊收录按照游戏原始合成规则能够成立的全部有效人物立绘组合。
